T0670.title: Command and Control
T0670.definition: Command and control is the mechanism attackers use to send instructions to compromised hosts and receive results through communication infrastructure.
T0670.description: C2 channels connect attackers with malware, botnets, or compromised devices to dispatch tasks, update configuration, exfiltrate data, and maintain persistence. They may use HTTP, DNS, messaging, peer-to-peer, or cloud services and evade detection through encryption, domain generation, and rapidly changing infrastructure. Defenses combine traffic baselines, threat intelligence, DNS analysis, and endpoint isolation.
T0670.usageExample: After the gateway detected an IoT device periodically contacting a C2 domain, it blocked egress and isolated the infected device.
